verse.verse_1: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),
verse.verse_3: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
verse.verse_5: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
verse.verse_7: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
verse.verse_8: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
